MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.35
Copyright 2019-2026 The MediaPipe Authors.

Toki bundles the MediaPipe Tasks Vision WebAssembly runtime from the
@mediapipe/tasks-vision npm package and the official float16 Hand Landmarker
model bundle. These files are used locally by the installed application.

Upstream project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Model source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
